candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: refined mobile app screenshot for Strata landing page.
Input image 1 is the actual app screenshot and edit target, not style inspiration.

Keep the existing app colors, typography, icons, wording, values and controls. Keep all numbers at their original values; do not invent populated health data or new features.

 All app text must remain German. Reconstruct clipped main data-screen heading as "Strata" followed by "Lokaler Zugriff auf Ihre Apple-Health-Daten".
